Package neqsim.process.equipment.reactor

Class AqueousHydrogenSulfideOxidationS8StreamApplicationBatchReceipt

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.reactor.AqueousHydrogenSulfideOxidationS8StreamApplicationBatchReceipt
public final class AqueousHydrogenSulfideOxidationS8StreamApplicationBatchReceipt extends Object
Verifies an ordered batch of externally applied S8 additions without mutating any stream.

Every request captures independent before and after stream snapshots. Verification delegates to AqueousHydrogenSulfideOxidationS8ComponentApplicationReceipt, preserves source order, requires unique target and application identities, and closes both the aggregate S8 increment and the aggregate total-mole increment.
